question: What is the primary goal of nursing research?

options.A: Increasing the cost of hospital admissions
options.B: Generating evidence to guide clinical practice
options.D: Reducing the number of nursing students

explanation: Nursing research systematically builds knowledge to improve patient care and guide clinical decisions. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h1)

question: Why is locally conducted research important in Nigerian healthcare?

options.A: Local research is the only way to get foreign grants
options.B: Nigerian hospitals refuse to use international textbooks
options.C: Local studies account for unique cultural and resource factors
options.D: Foreign guidelines never mention common diseases

explanation: Context-specific research addresses local disease patterns and environmental realities better than imported guidelines. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h1)

question: What model did early Nigerian nursing education rely on?
explanation: Early nursing training in Nigeria followed the British tradition, focusing on practical tasks rather than academic research. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h2)

question: What milestone shifted Nigerian nursing toward scientific inquiry?

options.A: The mandatory retirement of senior matrons
options.B: The creation of university degree programs for nurses
options.C: The complete ban on traditional medicine practices
options.D: The removal of doctors from hospital management

explanation: University education introduced formal research training into the nursing curriculum. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h2)

question: A major practical barrier for ward nurses participating in research is:

options.A: Heavy patient workloads and lack of time
options.B: Mandatory research hours in every shift
options.C: An excess of available research assistants
options.D: Too many functional digital health records

explanation: Busy clinical duties consume the time nurses need to engage in research activities. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h3)

question: How does poor hospital record-keeping affect retrospective studies?

options.A: It automatically increases research funding grants
options.B: It speeds up the process of data analysis
options.C: It leads to missing data and unreliable results
options.D: It ensures absolute privacy for every patient

explanation: Incomplete or disorganized patient files make historical data extraction inaccurate. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h3)

question: The most common way many Nigerian nurses finance their initial research is through:
explanation: Due to scarce institutional grants, researchers frequently rely on their own personal funds. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h4)

question: Which of the following is NOT a typical resource constraint for local researchers?

options.A: Lack of dedicated institutional funding grants
options.B: High costs of purchasing statistical analysis software
options.C: Limited access to reliable internet connectivity
options.D: An abundance of free paid academic journal subscriptions

explanation: Paid journals are expensive and restricted, meaning a surplus of free subscriptions does not exist as a constraint. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h4)

question: Why is obtaining true voluntary consent difficult in some clinical settings?

options.A: Doctors forbid nurses from talking to patients
options.B: Consent forms are always written in complex Latin
options.C: Patients are legally required to join all studies
options.D: Patients might fear refusal will compromise their treatment

explanation: Vulnerable patients often worry that saying no to a researcher will stop doctors from treating them properly. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h5)

question: A nurse researcher dealing with low literacy participants must:

options.A: Skip the consent process to save valuable time
options.B: Use clear verbal explanations alongside simple consent forms
options.C: Force family members to sign without reading anything
options.D: Refuse to include any patient who cannot write

explanation: Informed consent requires clear communication that matches the literacy level of the participant. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h5)

question: How does mobile health (mHealth) assist modern nursing research?

options.A: By eliminating all costs associated with data analysis
options.B: By replacing the need for ethical committee approval
options.C: By automating the writing of final journal articles
options.D: By enabling remote data collection and patient tracking

explanation: mHealth tools allow researchers to gather information and monitor patients outside the hospital environment. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h6)

question: What is a major benefit of international mentorship networks for novice researchers?

options.A: They guarantee automatic publication in high-impact journals
options.B: They provide unlimited funding for personal expenses
options.C: They reduce professional isolation and build research capacity
options.D: They remove the requirement for institutional review boards

explanation: Connecting with experienced scholars helps guide beginners through the challenges of scientific inquiry. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h6)

question: What strategy helps clinical nurses find time for scientific investigations?

options.A: Stopping all bedside nursing duties during weekdays
options.B: Allocating protected research time within hospital shifts
options.C: Asking nurses to conduct studies exclusively at night
options.D: Reducing the total number of patients admitted to wards

explanation: Dedicated time allows nurses to step away from clinical tasks to focus on study protocols. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h7)

question: Why are interprofessional research teams valuable in healthcare studies?

options.A: They bypass hospital ethical committee reviews
options.B: They ensure that nurses do all the work alone
options.C: They combine diverse skills to improve study quality
options.D: They prevent the need for any financial investments

explanation: Collaborating with experts from other fields like statistics or IT strengthens the overall research design. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T6#GNS217_U2_T6_h7)
